name: Mei Mei
source:
The gorgeous Cosmic Wraith is accompanied by the plant-type super life form "Moririn". She kind, straightforward and loves being pampered. She is an erotic grown woman. She loves all things cute and beautiful, She loves her beautiful self the most because of her narcissism. 

She likes to go at her own pace.  Any man who is favored by Mei Mei becomes her mate. She will service her lover sweetly and affectionately in order to breed with her. Because of her personality, one might think that she gets bored easily, in reality, she is dedicated towards her mate and will not let him go until his death.
